page.title: 時間接続詞をタイムラインで整理

analysis.summaryJa: 時間接続詞は出来事を時間軸に配置する。whenは出来事の位置、whileは二つの進行の重なり、sinceは起点から基準時までの継続を示し、文脈によって理由にもなる。before・afterは前後関係、untilはある時点までの継続、by the timeは節を伴う期限を表す。as soon as・no sooner ... than・onceは直後や成立後の展開を示す。
grammarPoints: whileによる二動作の重なり
sinceによる過去の起点から現在まで
before / after / untilの順序と継続
byとby the timeの後続形の違い
as soon as / no sooner ... than / onceの直後関係
visualEvidence: 二本の青い線がwhileの同時進行を表している
緑の起点からnowまで伸びる線がsinceを示す
before・after・untilの小型タイムラインが順序を可視化している
by noonとby the time＋節の期限比較が並ぶ
ベル・砂時計・地図が直後表現三種を示している
commonTraps: since節の起点と現在完了の継続を逆にする
untilを完了期限のbyと混同する
by the timeの後に名詞だけを置く
未来の時間節で不要なwillを使う
no soonerの倒置とthanの組み合わせを崩す

questions.prompt: Please remain on the line ------- the agent returns with your account information.

choices.A: by
choices.B: after
choices.C: until
choices.D: since

choices.A: While
choices.B: Since
choices.C: Until
choices.D: Once

choices.C: while
choices.D: since

choices.A: until

choices.C: after
choices.D: since

questions.prompt: ------- the courier arrived, the package was transferred to cold storage.

choices.B: As soon as
choices.C: Even though
choices.D: By the time of

choices.B: Since
choices.C: While
choices.D: By

questions.explanationJa: By the time＋節という期限構造を完成するByが適切です。

choices.A: than
choices.B: when
choices.C: until
choices.D: because

questions.translationJa: ドアが開くやいなや、待っていた客が店に入りました。
questions.explanationJa: No sooner ... thanの固定構文を完成するthanが必要です。

questions.prompt: ------- employees complete the security course, they may request building access.

choices.A: Until
choices.B: Once
choices.C: Whereas
choices.D: Despite

questions.translationJa: 従業員はいったん安全研修を修了すれば、入館権限を申請できます。
questions.explanationJa: 条件となる出来事の成立後を示すOnceが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly expresses overlapping actions.

choices.A: While I updated the records tomorrow, Mina will answering calls.
choices.B: During I was updating the records, Mina answered customer calls.
choices.C: While updating I the records, Mina answered customer calls.
choices.D: While I was updating the records, Mina answered customer calls.

questions.translationJa: 私が記録を更新している間、ミナは顧客電話に対応しました。
questions.explanationJa: while節と主節が二つの同時進行の動作を正しく示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly uses “since” for a starting point.

choices.A: The printer worked reliably since the technician has replaced its sensor tomorrow.
choices.B: The printer has worked reliably since the technician replaced its sensor.
choices.C: The printer has worked reliably until the technician replaced its sensor and still does.
choices.D: Since the technician replacing its sensor, the printer reliably.

questions.translationJa: 技術者がセンサーを交換して以来、プリンターは安定して動作しています。
questions.explanationJa: 主節の現在完了と過去形のsince節が起点から現在までを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with the correct future time clause.

choices.A: We will notify applicants when the interview schedule will be finalized.
choices.B: We notify applicants when will the interview schedule be finalized.
choices.C: We will notify applicants when the interview schedule is finalized.
choices.D: When the interview schedule finalizing, we will notify applicants.

questions.translationJa: 面接日程が確定したら、応募者に通知します。
questions.explanationJa: 未来の時間を表すwhen節では現在形isを使い、主節にwillを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly uses “until”.

choices.A: The lobby will remain closed until the floor is dry.
choices.B: The lobby will remain closed by the floor is dry.
choices.C: The lobby will close until the floor will be dry.
choices.D: Until the dry floor, the lobby remain closed.

questions.translationJa: 床が乾くまで、ロビーは閉鎖されたままです。
questions.explanationJa: 状態の継続終点をuntil＋節で正しく示しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly uses “by the time”.

choices.A: By the time of the guests arrived, the staff had prepared every table.
choices.B: Until the time the guests arrived, the staff had already prepare every table.
choices.C: By the guests arrived time, every table had prepared.
choices.D: By the time the guests arrived, the staff had prepared every table.

questions.translationJa: 来客が到着するまでには、スタッフは全テーブルを準備済みでした。
questions.explanationJa: by the time＋節と過去完了で期限前の完了を表しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with the correct inverted immediate-sequence pattern.

choices.A: No sooner the meeting had ended when the cleanup crew entered.
choices.B: No sooner had the meeting ended then the cleanup crew entered.
choices.C: No sooner had the meeting ended than the cleanup crew entered.
choices.D: No sooner did the meeting ended than the cleanup crew entered.

questions.translationJa: 会議が終わるやいなや、清掃チームが入りました。
questions.explanationJa: No soonerの倒置had＋主語＋過去分詞とthanの組み合わせが正しいです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly shows an event occurring afterward.

choices.A: After the payment confirmed, the order was released for shipment.
choices.B: After the payment was confirmed, the order was released for shipment.
choices.C: After of the payment was confirmed, the order was released.
choices.D: The order after released because the payment was confirmed.

questions.translationJa: 支払いが確認された後、注文品は出荷工程へ回されました。
questions.explanationJa: after節が確認を先、出荷を後として正しく並べています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly uses “as soon as”.

choices.A: As soon as the replacement will arrive, we will install it.
choices.B: As soon the replacement arrives as, we will install it.
choices.C: The replacement as soon as arriving, we will installed it.
choices.D: As soon as the replacement arrives, we will install it.

questions.translationJa: 交換品が到着し次第、取り付けます。
questions.explanationJa: 未来の時間節は現在形arrivesを使い、As soon asで直後を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly uses “once”.

choices.A: Once the contract will be signed, both parties receive a copy.
choices.B: Once of the signed contract, both parties will receive a copy.
choices.C: Once the contract is signed, both parties will receive a copy.
choices.D: The contract once signing, both parties received a copy.

questions.translationJa: 契約書に署名されれば、両当事者に写しが届きます。
questions.explanationJa: once節で成立条件を現在形にし、主節で将来結果を示しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly distinguishes “by” from “until”.

choices.A: Please submit the expense form by Friday.
choices.B: Please submit the expense form until Friday.
choices.C: Please continue submitting the one form by Friday every moment.
choices.D: Please submit until the expense form Friday.

questions.translationJa: 金曜日までに経費用紙を提出してください。
questions.explanationJa: 一回の提出の完了期限にはbyを使い、継続のuntilは使いません。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Stay in the waiting area until your name is called.”

choices.A: Do not leave the waiting area before someone calls your name.
choices.B: Leave the waiting area as soon as you arrive.
choices.C: Your name will be called because you left early.
choices.D: Wait only after the office has closed.

questions.translationJa: 名前を呼ばれる前に待合区域を離れないでください。
questions.explanationJa: untilの継続終点をnot ... beforeで同じ意味にしています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I have used this software since I joined the company.”

choices.A: I stopped using the software before joining the company.
choices.B: I will first use the software after leaving the company.
choices.C: Joining occurred because the software is no longer used.
choices.D: My use of the software began when I joined and continues now.

questions.translationJa: 入社時にソフト利用を始め、現在も続けています。
questions.explanationJa: sinceは過去の起点から現在までの継続を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “By the time we arrived, the store had closed.”

choices.A: The store remained open until after our arrival.
choices.B: We arrived before the store opened for the day.
choices.C: The store closed before we reached it.
choices.D: Our arrival caused the store to stay open.

questions.translationJa: 私たちが着く前に、店は閉まっていました。
questions.explanationJa: by the timeと過去完了が先行する閉店を示しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “While the auditor reviewed the accounts, the assistant organized receipts.”

choices.A: The assistant waited until the audit ended before doing anything.
choices.B: The account review and receipt organization happened at the same time.
choices.C: The auditor organized receipts because no accounts existed.
choices.D: Both activities necessarily occurred on different days.

questions.translationJa: 会計確認と領収書整理は同時に行われました。
questions.explanationJa: whileが二つの進行を時間的に重ねています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Call me as soon as the supplier responds.”

choices.A: Call me immediately after you receive the supplier’s response.
choices.B: Call before the supplier has had any chance to respond.
choices.C: Wait several days after the response before calling.
choices.D: The supplier will respond only because I call you.

questions.translationJa: 供給業者から返答を受けた直後に電話してください。
questions.explanationJa: as soon asは直後をimmediately afterと同じく表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Once the trial period ends, the monthly fee applies.”

choices.A: The monthly fee is charged throughout the free trial only.
choices.B: The trial begins after all monthly payments stop.
choices.C: The monthly charge begins after the trial period is over.
choices.D: No fee applies even after the trial has ended.

questions.translationJa: 試用期間が終わると、月額料金が発生します。
questions.explanationJa: Onceは出来事成立後の展開を示すためafterで言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Check the address before you send the parcel.”

choices.A: Send the parcel first and check the address later.
choices.B: The address will be checked while no parcel is sent.
choices.C: Do not verify the address until delivery is complete.
choices.D: Verify the address first, and send the parcel afterward.

questions.translationJa: 最初に住所を確認し、その後で荷物を送ってください。
questions.explanationJa: beforeが示す二動作の順序をfirstとafterwardで表しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “No sooner had we submitted the form than a confirmation arrived.”

choices.A: A confirmation arrived immediately after we submitted the form.
choices.B: The confirmation arrived long before the form was submitted.
choices.C: No confirmation came because the form was incomplete.
choices.D: We delayed submission after receiving several confirmations.

questions.translationJa: 用紙を提出するとすぐに確認が届きました。
questions.explanationJa: No sooner ... thanはimmediately afterと同じ直後関係です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The lights turn off when the office becomes empty.”

choices.A: The lights remain on because the office is empty.
choices.B: The lights switch off at the time no one remains in the office.
choices.C: The office becomes empty only while the lights are repaired.
choices.D: People leave long after the lights never change.

questions.translationJa: 事務所に誰もいなくなる時点で照明が消えます。
questions.explanationJa: whenが自動消灯の反復する時間位置を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We rested after we completed the inventory count.”

choices.A: We rested throughout the count and never completed it.
choices.B: The inventory was counted because the break continued.
choices.C: We finished counting the inventory before taking a break.
choices.D: We took a break first and began counting much later.

questions.translationJa: 在庫数を数え終えてから休憩しました。
questions.explanationJa: afterの関係をbeforeを用いて逆側から同じ順序で表しています。

questions.prompt: The loading crew will begin ------- the safety inspector gives permission.

choices.A: while
choices.B: when
choices.C: because of
choices.D: whereas

questions.translationJa: 安全検査官が許可した時点で、積み込み班が作業を始めます。
questions.explanationJa: 許可という出来事に開始時点を置くwhenが適切です。

questions.prompt: Please wait here ------- the shuttle returns from Terminal 2.

choices.A: by
choices.B: after
choices.C: since
choices.D: until

questions.prompt: ------- the manager was speaking with the client, her assistant prepared the revised estimate.

choices.A: While
choices.B: Until
choices.C: Once
choices.D: Before

questions.prompt: The clinic has offered online appointments ------- it moved to the new building.

choices.A: until
choices.B: while
choices.C: since
choices.D: before

questions.translationJa: 診療所は新しい建物へ移って以来、オンライン予約を提供しています。
questions.explanationJa: 移転を起点に現在まで続くためsinceです。

questions.prompt: ------- the time the final guest checked out, the housekeeping team had prepared ten rooms.

choices.A: Until
choices.B: Since
choices.C: While
choices.D: By

questions.translationJa: 最後の宿泊客がチェックアウトするまでには、清掃チームは10室を準備済みでした。

questions.prompt: The doors opened ------- the fire alarm test was complete.

choices.A: until
choices.B: after
choices.C: while
choices.D: since

questions.translationJa: 火災警報試験が完了した後、扉が開きました。
questions.explanationJa: 試験完了を先、開扉を後に置くafterが適切です。

questions.prompt: ------- you learn the updated filing system, daily tasks become much faster.

choices.A: Once
choices.B: Until
choices.C: Whereas
choices.D: Despite

questions.translationJa: いったん更新された書類管理方法を覚えると、日常業務はずっと速くなります。
questions.explanationJa: 一度条件が成立した後の変化をOnceが示します。

questions.prompt: No sooner had the announcement been posted ------- applications began arriving.

choices.A: when
choices.B: until
choices.C: because
choices.D: than

questions.translationJa: 発表が掲載されるやいなや、応募が届き始めました。
questions.explanationJa: No sooner ... thanの固定構文なのでthanです。

questions.prompt: We will issue the refund ------- we receive the returned item.

choices.A: as long as
choices.B: even though
choices.C: as soon as
choices.D: by the time of

questions.prompt: Back up the database ------- installing the security update.

choices.A: until
choices.B: before

choices.D: while

questions.translationJa: セキュリティ更新をインストールする前に、データベースをバックアップしてください。
questions.explanationJa: インストールより先に行う動作をbefore＋動名詞で示します。
